to 13.0 JUL 204

All Regional Provident Fund Commissioners,
In-Charge of Regional/Sub Regional Offices.

Subject : Transfer of Past Accumulation on withdrawal of relaxation and on
surrender of exemption - instructions thereof- regarding.

Sir,

It is observed that the Regional Provident Fund Commissioners, In-Charge of Regional/Sub
Regional Offices withdraw relaxation granted by them to the establishments under Paragraph 79 of
the Employees’ Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 and do not take action in time to get the Past
Accumulation of the members transferred from the Trust to EPFO to protect the interest of the
members.

2. A number of complaints are received at Head Office from the members, trade unions, Ministry
etc. that the provident fund accumulations are at stake. At times, the establishments take shelter
under the EPFAT and High Courts and obtain stay against withdrawal of relaxation granted to them.
This delays the transfer of Past Accumulation and thus puts the hard-earned money of the workers in
danger which jeopardize their interest. The Central Provident Fund Commissioner, while reviewing the
cases pending grant of exemption, expressed his concern and directed to call for the details of cases
where transfer of past accumulation is yet to be effected pursuant to withdrawal of relaxation. All the
Regional Provident Fund Commissioners, In-Charge of Regional/Sub Regional Offices are
directed to transmit the information on withdrawal of relaxation and transfer of past
accumulation in the following format on monthly basis.

3. Similarly, the Regional Provident Fund Commissioners, In-Charge of Regional/Sub Regional
Offices are not timely forwarding the proposals to Head Office (i) where the exempted establishments
express their willingness to surrender exemption granted to them by the Appropriate Government and
(ii) where there is urgent need for cancellation of exemption due to violations of the conditions
stipulated in Appendix-A to Paragraph 27AA of the Employees’ Provident Funds Scheme,i952 by the
exempted establishments. This creates embarrassment at Head Office while sending the proposals to
Appropriate Government for cancellation. Further, while sending the proposals for cancellation of
exemption, in cases where the exempted establishments express their willingness to surrender
exemption granted to them, Regional Provident Fund Commissioners shall ensure that the
establishment transfers the Past Accumulation.

4. Failure to adhere to the instructions will be viewed seriously.

Yours faithfully,
